protocol.name: stratified 5-fold CV (shared fingerprint), train on original, evaluate on degraded
protocol.perturbation: fret_error' = |fret_error - delta|, delta ~ N(0, (lam^2-1)*sigma^2) per row; fret_uncertainty' = lam * fret_uncertainty. Derived from the Task 1 measurement model d_obs = z_true + eps, eps ~ N(0, sigma^2).

non_fret_control.note: Same multipliers and noise scale as the FRET perturbation, applied to a feature with no label information. Reported as a secondary control.
